newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Palo Verde electricity has record volume Wed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Palo Verde electricity has record volume Wed.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said its Palo Verde electricity futures contract hit record volume of 599 trades on Wednesday.
The trade level beat out the previous Palo Verde trade record of 319 contracts, set on January 24, a NYMEX spokeswoman said.
The Palo Verde March futures contract settled down 55 cents at $13.10 per megawatt hour on Wednesday.
The exchange launched electricity futures trading March 29, 1996, with its introduction of the Palo Verde and California-Oregon Border (COB) contracts.
